title: Cap. II Sol. Arg. 7: weak will can lose; under divine direction the elect cannot
pass_a_gloss: Although therefore, if the elect are viewed from the weakness of their own will, they can lose the crown; yet if they are viewed insofar as this their will lies under the most efficacious Divine direction, they cannot lose it.
pass_b_english: So if you look only at the elect's weak will, they can lose the crown. Look at that same will under God's most effective direction, and they cannot.
source_text: Quamvis igitur, si spectentur electi ex propriae voluntatis infirmitate, possunt amittere coronam; tamen si spectentur, qua subjacet haec illorum voluntas efficacissimae directioni Divinae, non possunt illam amittere.
